extractedText: Visit Zhuhai: China’s Elegant Coastal Garden City Author Thomas Schulz | Passionate traveler and writerLast updated: June 15, 2026 Zhuhai Grand Theatre (adrian2019, pixabay) Photo credit: The twin clamshell domes of the Zhuhai Grand Theatre on Yeli Island Tucked along the western shore of the Pearl River Estuary in southern China’s Guangdong Province, Zhuhai is a coastal city of palm-lined promenades, 146 offshore islands, and a soundtrack of crashing surf that you don’t usually associate with mainland China. A short walk across the Gongbei border connects the city to Macau; the 55-kilometer Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge — the world’s longest sea crossing — links it directly to Hong Kong’s airport. Yet despite its position at the heart of the Greater Bay Area’s economic engine, Zhuhai keeps a low-rise, garden-city feel that makes it one of China’s most livable destinations and a refreshingly uncrowded alternative to its neighbors. Daily highlights include the Penguin Parade, a Jet Ski stunt show and a nightly Ocean Parade with fireworks. A late-May to early-June promotion lets each paying adult bring one young child free. Adult tickets from around 350 CNY. [Source]2026-05-22Zhuhai Opera House — ‘Sun & Moon Shell’ Night Light ShowChina’s only opera house built on an island, the twin-shell landmark on Yeli Island stages opera, ballet and symphony, from Turandot to Swan Lake. After dark, the seashell facades light up over the bay, making the venue itself a free evening attraction. Indoor performances vary in price. A striking architectural and cultural icon. [Source]2026-05-22New Yuan Ming Palace — Royal Grand CeremonyA 1:1 reconstruction of 18 scenes from Beijing’s lost Yuanming Gardens, split into royal, Jiangnan-garden and Western complexes. The evening ‘Royal Grand Ceremony’, plus a Palace Magic Show and hourly fountain shows, run in the palace theatre. Park entry is free; performances are paid, with the show around 85 CNY. Open 8:30-21:00. A grand cultural spectacle. [Source]2026-06-19 to 2026-06-21Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu) 2026Over the three-day Duanwu holiday, the coastal city of Zhuhai on the Pearl River estuary holds dragon boat races and observes traditions of eating zongzi and hanging mugwort. As a Guangdong waterfront city, it is a traditional venue for holiday races. Free to watch. A lively celebration of a cherished Chinese festival. [Source]2026-05-22Wanshan Archipelago Island GetawaysDong’ao Island sits at the heart of the 104-island Wanshan Archipelago off Zhuhai, with 15km of coastline, sandy beaches and Qing-dynasty fortress ruins, while nearby Wailingding offers Lovers Avenue and scenic beaches. Ferries run from Zhuhai’s ports. Round-trip ferry plus scenic-spot tickets vary. Peak-summer sailings book out, so reserve ahead.
